title: Evaluation of phytochemicals from Thymus serpyllum as potential drug candidates to manage oxidative stress in transition dairy cows.
authors: Azhar, Jahanzaib; Nadeem, Asif; Javed, Maryam; Ahmad, Hafiz Ishfaq; Hassan, Faiz-Ul; Shah, Faisal Sheraz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物化学物抑制牛NF-kappaB以缓解奶牛氧化应激，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Dairy cows undergo immense stress and experience autoimmune reactions during the transition period, majorly due to the generation of ROS in the body. So, pharmacological approaches are needed to manage oxidative stress in the transition cows. Recently, the use of phytochemicals as feed additives in cows' nutrition has gained interest in managing various disease conditions. In the current study, we have evaluated the potential effects of phytochemicals derived from methanolic extract of Thymus serpyllum against oxidative stress and autoimmunity via inhibition of bovine nuclear factor kappa B (NF-kappaB). The free radical scavenging activity of Thymus serpyllum seed and leaf extracts was 71.8 and 75.6%, respectively at 100 microg/mL concentration. Similarly, both extracts displayed radicals reducing power and inhibition of lipid-peroxidation maximally at 100 microg/mL. A total of 52 bioactive compounds were identified when the plant extract was characterized by the GC-MS analysis, and five (Thymol, Luteolin 7-o-glucuronide, Rosmarinic acid, Apigenin 6,8-di-c-glucoside, Kaempferol) had binding free energy values of -11.6433, -10.002, -8.2615, -7.1714, -6.4870, respectively, in complexes with bovine NF-kappaB. Through computational analysis, the screened compounds showed good pharmacokinetic parameters, including non-toxicity, non-carcinogenic, high gastrointestinal absorption and thus can serve as potential drug candidates. MD simulation studies predicted the stability of complexes and the complex of Kaempferol was most stable based on RSMD value and MM/GBSA binding energy. The biochemical assays and computational studies indicated that Thymus serpyllum could be used as a promising feed additive in dairy cows to manage oxidative stress during the transition period.Communicated by Ramaswamy H. Sarma.
abstract_zh: 奶牛在过渡期承受巨大应激并经历自身免疫反应，主要归因于体内活性氧（ROS）的生成。因此，需要药理学方法来管理过渡期奶牛的氧化应激。近年来，在奶牛营养中添加植物化学物作为饲料添加剂，在管理多种疾病状况方面引起了关注。在本研究中，我们评估了源自百里香（Thymus serpyllum）甲醇提取物的植物化学物，通过抑制牛核因子κB（NF-kappaB）对氧化应激和自身免疫的潜在效应。百里香种子和叶片提取物在100微克/毫升浓度下的自由基清除活性分别为71.8%和75.6%。同样，两种提取物在100微克/毫升浓度下均表现出自由基还原能力，并最大程度地抑制脂质过氧化。通过GC-MS分析表征植物提取物时，共鉴定出52种生物活性化合物，其中五种（百里酚（Thymol）、木犀草素7-O-葡萄糖醛酸苷（Luteolin 7-o-glucuronide）、迷迭香酸（Rosmarinic acid）、芹菜素6,8-二-C-葡萄糖苷（Apigenin 6,8-di-c-glucoside）、山柰酚（Kaempferol））在与牛NF-kappaB复合物中的结合自由能值分别为-11.6433、-10.002、-8.2615、-7.1714、-6.4870。通过计算分析，筛选出的化合物显示出良好的药代动力学参数，包括无毒性、无致癌性、高胃肠吸收性，因此可作为潜在的候选药物。分子动力学（MD）模拟研究预测了复合物的稳定性，其中山柰酚复合物基于RSMD值和MM/GBSA结合能最为稳定。生化测定和计算研究表明，百里香可作为奶牛中一种有前景的饲料添加剂，用于管理过渡期的氧化应激。由Ramaswamy H. Sarma通讯。
